product_metadata.title: Kitchen + Home Thin Bins Collapsible Containers – Set of 4 Rectangle Silicone Food Storage Containers – BPA Free, Microwave, Dishwasher and Freezer Safe
features: VALUE SET - Set of 4 assorted stackable and collapsible silicone containers - Includes one of each size for the best value: Small (10.5 oz), Medium (18 oz), Large (26 oz), and Extra Large (43 oz). From storing dried foods to wet foods, leftovers to meal prep, and indoor to outdoor, this versatile set is the perfect solution for your different food storage needs.

DESIGN – Our snap on lids create an airtight vacuum seal that will keep your food secured and fresher longer. Featuring an air vent for microwave heating and four convenient sizes, Thin Bins are great for meal prep or lunch box set. Leak proof design makes them perfect for indoor food storage, work, camping, hiking, travel and more.

SAVE SPACE – Each container is collapsible to 1/3 its original size for easy compact storage and organization. Stop searching through your cluttered container cabinet looking for the right lid for your containers. Our lids snap shut making them stackable and saving you 60% more space! Thin Bins are the perfect choice for small apartments, dorms, RVs, camping and more!

SAFE & TEMPERATURE RESISTANT – Thin Bins are made from 100% FDA compliant non-toxic, BPA free, food grade silicone. They are odorless, tasteless, leak-proof, and nonstick. Our temperature resistant silicone makes them microwave, freezer and dishwasher safe. Great for storing leftovers in the fridge and microwavable for when you’re ready to enjoy your meal. Just pull up on the air valve or remove the lid before heating. Then pop them in the dishwasher when you are done for hassle-free cleaning.

100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEED – We are so confident in the quality of our Thin Bins that we will stand behind our product with a replacement or your money back. Each set comes with a manufacturer’s warranty, so you can buy with confidence!
